pages.raw_meta: Free TransUnion® credit report & score. Free credit monitoring, alerts and personalized offers. All free, all in 1.  No credit card required. Learn more.
raw_blocks: Free credit reports, free credit scores 1 and personalized credit card offers with CardMatch™ from Bankrate 2
Completely free, no credit card required
Take control of your credit health
A fraud alert is free and notifies creditors to take extra steps to verify your identity before extending credit.
Add a free freeze to control who can access your credit information. Unfreeze to apply for credit.
Get your free weekly credit report from annualcreditreport.com to stay on top of your credit health.
Confirm information on your credit report for free, start a dispute or check a current dispute status.
1 Your credit score is calculated based on the VantageScore® 3.0 model. Lenders and insurers may use different scores to evaluate your eligibility.

Offers do not represent all available financial services, companies or products. Availability may vary by state. Please review the offer details and verify all terms and conditions before applying. TransUnion does not endorse or recommend any lender or provider
